notes:
### The window stays awake through an ingest, Resolve gets the card in one batch, and an agent sees the footage the way you do

- **Ingest no longer freezes the window.** Auto-decide queues its jobs on a
  worker and reads the failure table once per press instead of once per add;
  the Resolve import lands a batch per bin instead of one call per clip, and
  the day's time-of-day timeline applies as soon as the card copy finishes
  rather than waiting for a Resync.
- **Photos.** Stills get a one-tile preview sheet, are described by their
  caption alone (no more three-minute structuring call), and the media band
  sorts by the day a clip was shot from either view.
- **Apple Log.** Apple Log and Apple Log 2 previews are corrected with Apple's
  published curve, an iPhone clip reads its own log from the container, and
  changing a camera's colour space rebuilds that camera's previews.
- **Audio sync.** A day anchor is asked of this project's cameras only, so
  another project's camera on the same date no longer blocks yours; adopted
  clips derive a clock from the file; a clockless clip is judged once, with
  one summary line per open instead of one per clip; and a toast names the
  camera that became the day's reference.
- **The lanes tell the truth.** A finished description counts as done whatever
  the ingest answer said; stragglers read as owed when the project asked;
  the Fast Describe lane is not held for a Qwen calibration it never runs;
  the summary refresh runs once per project; the Analyse sheet reopens on the
  answer you already gave; the voice check runs one model per thread.
- **MCP.** The agent guide fits clients that truncate instructions at 2,000
  characters, with the full guide behind search_help('guide'). cover_with_broll
  and the bin tools are listed again; cover warns about uncovered spine and
  repeated clips and takes a track-level silent_reason; edits answer with what
  changed. Every clip carries a role (interview, piece to camera, b-roll,
  slate, photo, audio); retakes group again; rows carry the take number, the
  room, a structured best window; photos are answered from the catalog; and
  list_people / clips_with_person ask who is in a shot. Whisper learns the
  project's names.
- **macOS memory** is measured as real footprint, so the describe child is
  recycled when it actually grows and the bundle names what holds the memory.
  A recycled describe child now answers: terminating an idle child had left
  its request queue locked, so the replacement hung and the rest of the run
  fell back in-process.
- Also since 1.3.9: lanes share the ffmpeg budget, Signals decodes each clip
  once, make_stringout, the in-app assistant's verbs and tool catalogue, a
  take's silences cut at the take level, and the 2026-09-10 diagnostics batch.
